tasks.description: Add a search box to the app's main navigation. The search box should be prominent and easily accessible. It should also have a clear placeholder text to guide the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given the app is loaded, when a user navigates to the main page, then a search box is visible.
Given the search box is empty, when a user clicks on it, then a placeholder text is displayed.

tasks.description: Develop a backend service to handle search queries. This service should accept user input, process it, and return relevant results. The service should be fast and efficient to ensure a smooth user experience.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search query, when the service is called, then relevant results are returned within 500ms.
Given an empty search query, when the service is called, then an empty result set is returned.

tasks.description: Develop a frontend component to render search results. The component should display results in a clear and user-friendly manner, including relevant information such as title, description, and links.
acceptance_criteria: Given search results, when the results are rendered, then each result includes a title, description, and link.
Given a large number of search results, when the results are rendered, then the results are paginated.

tasks.description: Develop a service to index app data for search. This service should ensure that all relevant data is indexed and up-to-date, allowing for fast and accurate search results.
acceptance_criteria: Given new app data, when the indexing service is run, then the data is indexed and searchable.
Given updated app data, when the indexing service is run, then the data is re-indexed and searchable.

tasks.description: Develop a comprehensive set of tests for the search feature. The tests should cover all aspects of the feature, including search query handling, result rendering, and indexing.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search query, when the search tests are run, then the tests pass and the search results are correct.
Given an empty search query, when the search tests are run, then the tests pass and an empty result set is returned.
